# Design point P019

## Description

A Git-based system would support very large repositories through client-side scaling optimizations without requiring a virtualized filesystem, while transferring repository data using Git packfiles. Repository writes would be evaluated across replicas with deterministic reference-update results, providing consistent acknowledgment or refusal behavior.
